description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams' used for filtering leave type search results within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends a base FilterParams class and primarily manages the 'name' filter and allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO for leave type search filters with a 'name' property and predefined sortable fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params and sets the default sort field to 'leaveType.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter.
